alert_summary: PowerShell was launched with an encoded command by wscript.exe executing a user-downloaded build-helper.js from C:\Users\ke.li.yam\Downloads, which downloads and executes a remote script from http://45.146.164.110:8080/u via Net.WebClient. The pattern was correlated 55 times, indicating repeated, widespread malicious download-and-execute activity rather than an isolated event.

risk_assessment.rationale: The encoded PowerShell payload uses IEX with Net.WebClient.DownloadString to pull and run code from http://45.146.164.110:8080/u. Execution is initiated by wscript.exe running build-helper.js from the user’s Downloads folder. Risk assessment confidence is high and 55 correlated occurrences are observed. Enrichment for the URL http://45.146.164.110:8080/u and IP 45.146.164.110 is unknown.

recommended_actions: Escalate to a human analyst for manual review
recommended_actions_freeform_experimenta: Isolate the affected host dev-klyam01.victimcorp.com and the user account ke.li.yam pending forensic imaging, block outbound connectivity to 45.146.164.110:8080 at perimeter and internal egress controls, hunt for the presence of build-helper.js and any dropped payloads across endpoints and the Downloads share, review wscript.exe and PowerShell execution logs for lateral movement or credential access, and notify incident response and the user’s manager for containment and evidence preservation.
triage_rationale_experimental: The alert shows a classic obfuscated download-and-execute chain with PowerShell -Enc invoked by wscript.exe from a user-downloaded script to pull code from an external IP, repeated 55 times, which is consistent with malicious activity rather than benign use.
